programmes.d: A watch that sets back time by five minutes, messes with Stephanie and Hunter’s budding romance.
An injured dancer and a shy Deaf girl overcome bullies, disability stigma, and other high school obstacles.
When a university student goes missing, her mother a former cop goes in search for her.
When her dog is killed, Tara cancels her wedding. But her dog's ghost and her small town have a surprise.
A marine biologist and a laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef.
Baseball coach Murph needs a miracle to save the team. Pitcher Micky with Aspergers may be the answer.
A struggling actress is hired to impersonate a woman for a business meeting, but soon finds her life in danger.
A cop trying to solve her the murder of daughter-in-law is drawn into a cat-and-mouse game with the killer.
Vicki has trouble building a case against Elana, a nightclub owner she knows is actually Medusa.
Vicki finds a necromancer and his assistant using dead athletes for a hideous underground sporting event.
Biopic of Anna Nicole Smith, Playmate and TV personality, culminates in a tragic fatal drug overdose.
Tiffany and her frenemy compete over wedding bookings, despite her not having a real fiancé.
Landscape architect Evie meets her match with new client Ryan, whose daughters are her biggest fan.
Tori hosts a “Bring it Back” themed luncheon for her neighbors in Hidden Hills with the help of Teddi Mellencamp.
Music exec Amanda clashes with brand rep Sam at a launch party, unaware she already met him online.
A marketing designer’s favourite foster dog is adopted by a down on his luck furniture designer.
